language.title: Welcome to Ritam
language.subtitle: Which language would you like to use? You can change it later in Profile.

sleep.title: Sleep comes first
sleep.subtitle: We set your wake-up time and sleep first — everything else is planned around it.
sleep.weekendWarning: More than an hour between weekdays and weekends throws off your rhythm (like a small jet lag). Try to keep them closer.

notifications.title: When should I check in?
notifications.subtitle: Your day plan arrives in the morning, a short check-in (1–2 min) in the evening. The check-in comes before wind-down, so planning isn't the last thing before sleep.

rules.title: Your rules
rules.subtitle: Up to 3 things you want to stop doing. Little by little — start with what matters most. You can also skip this and add them later.
rules.name: Name
rules.whyPlaceholder: e.g. I want to wake up rested
rules.hint: For now they apply every day, all day — you can fine-tune them later.

permission.title: Notifications are off
permission.body: Without notifications you won't get your morning plan, the evening check-in or block reminders. Turn them on in your device settings.

morning.title: Good morning
morning.body: Your day is ready. Check the plan and rate your sleep.

evening.title: Evening check-in
evening.body: Two minutes: how did today go, and what's on tomorrow?

windDown.title: Time to wind down
windDown.body: Bedtime is coming up. Put the screen down and slow down.

today.emptyBody: Add your first block for today — a task or a fixed commitment.
today.loadError: Today's blocks could not be loaded.
today.actionError: The change was not saved. Please try again.

evening.saveError: The check-in wasn't saved. Try again.

card.title: Evening check-in
card.pendingBody: A minute or two: checklist, rules and a rating for the day.
card.doneBody: Day rating: {{rating}}/5. You can still edit it.

checklist.title: Today's checklist
checklist.subtitle: Did everything go OK? Whatever didn't can move to later.
checklist.empty: Nothing was planned today — let's move on.
checklist.question: Was it OK: {{title}}
checklist.commentPlaceholder: e.g. ran out of time, too tired…
checklist.laterHint: The rest gets a new block at the same time.

rules.title: Rules
rules.subtitle: How did your rules go today?

done.title: Day logged
done.body: Nice job taking a minute for yourself. See you tomorrow.

tomorrow.title: What's on tomorrow?
tomorrow.subtitle: Add commitments and tasks for tomorrow. Times stack from the morning — tap an item to change them.
tomorrow.pickHint: Adds a block in the next free slot.
tomorrow.empty: Nothing yet — use a quick pick or type.
tomorrow.saveError: The plan wasn't saved. Try again.
tomorrow.doneBody: New blocks: {{count}}. See you in the morning.

sleep.title: How did you sleep?
sleep.subtitle: Filled in from your goals — adjust if needed, then save.
sleep.invalid: Wake-up time must be after the time you fell asleep.

cards.title: Your day
cards.emptyBody: Add blocks on the Today tab — tap Adjust.
cards.label: {{position}} of {{total}}: {{title}}, {{time}}, {{kind}}

morning.adjustHint: Closes the brief and opens today's schedule for editing

card.title: Morning brief
card.heading: How did you sleep?
card.body: Log your sleep and see today's plan.

streak.a11y: Days in a row with the evening check-in: {{count}}
streak.hintDone: Today's check-in counts toward your streak.
streak.hintKeep: Fill in the evening check-in to grow your streak.
streak.hintStart: Today's evening check-in starts a new streak.

diagnosis.title: Daily diagnosis
diagnosis.loadError: The diagnosis couldn't be loaded. Try again later.

summary.better: Done {{done}} of {{total}} planned — a step forward from yesterday.
summary.same: Done {{done}} of {{total}} planned — the rhythm is holding.
summary.worse: Done {{done}} of {{total}} planned. Yesterday went better, and that's okay — tomorrow is a new chance.
summary.first: Done {{done}} of {{total}} planned. From tomorrow we'll compare each day with the one before.
summary.betterNoPlan: Better than yesterday, even without a plan today.
summary.sameNoPlan: No plan today; otherwise about the same as yesterday.
summary.worseNoPlan: No plan today, and your rules went better yesterday.
summary.firstNoPlan: Day logged. We need a few days with a plan to compare.

praise.allDone: Everything planned got done ({{total}}/{{total}}). Keep it up.
praise.planBetter: You did more of your plan than yesterday ({{done}}/{{total}}).
praise.rulesKept: All rules kept ({{count}}). That's willpower in action.
praise.bedtime: You went to bed at your planned time.
praise.streak: {{days}} days in a row of check-ins. The habit is forming.
praise.goodRating: You rated the day {{rating}}/5 — remember what helped.
praise.showedUp: You took a minute to log your day. That's exactly how habits are built.

noticed.trigger: The rule “{{rule}}” was broken by a trigger: {{trigger}}.

misses.evening: Most misses were in the evening ({{count}}). Your energy may drop late in the day.
misses.morning: Most misses were in the morning ({{count}}). The morning may need a gentler start.

noticed.lowRatingDespitePlan: The plan got done, yet the day didn't feel good — maybe something outside the plan is weighing on you.
noticed.goodRatingDespitePlan: The plan didn't get done, yet the day felt good — maybe the plan didn't fit the day.

problems.lowPlan: Less than half of the plan got done ({{done}}/{{total}}).
problems.shortSleep: You slept only {{hours}} h — that shows all day.

ideas.ruleTrigger: For “{{rule}}”: decide in advance what you'll do when “{{trigger}}” shows up again.
ideas.ruleNote: For “{{rule}}”: next time note what set it off — that's how we find the pattern.
ideas.smallerPlan: Tomorrow, plan one block less and put the most important one first.
ideas.eveningEarlier: Tomorrow, try moving your hardest evening block earlier in the day.
ideas.earlierBed: Tonight, try going to bed 15 minutes earlier.
ideas.fewerMoves: Tomorrow, plan only what you really have time for — fewer moves.
ideas.keepRhythm: Keep the same rhythm tomorrow — no new changes.

score.title: Day score
score.inProgress: In progress · final after the evening check-in
score.empty: Your day score appears as soon as you log something: plan, rules or sleep.
